sections.Profile:
The "Piccadilly" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on April 4, 1956, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
